# CONTENTS
(0) FUNCTIONS: defines main functions
(1) Aggregate h2WGS and enrichment per LD bins per ancestry (for one trait)
(2) META analyse (1)
(3) Aggregate h2WGS LD bins per all rare and all common bins, or compute ratio of rare to common (for one trait)
(4) META analyse simulation outputs (for one trait)


# 0. Functions

FUNCTION `calc_sums`: calculating h2 sums + SEs + p

```{r}
calc_sums <- function(data) {
  vc_num <- nrow(data) - 1 # Number of variance components (excluding total row)
  half   <- vc_num / 2     # Number of annotation categories (n_cat)
  
  m    <- data$m[1:vc_num]
  vars <- data$var[1:vc_num]
  
  # Extract raw variance component covariance matrix (Sigma)
  Sigma <- as.matrix(
    data[1:vc_num, (ncol(data) - vc_num):(ncol(data) - 1)]
  )
  stopifnot(all(dim(Sigma) == c(vc_num, vc_num)))
  
  # Allocate output vectors (n_cat + 1 rows, where last row is Genome Total)
  v               <- numeric(half + 1)
  v_var           <- numeric(half + 1)
  v_cat_tot_covar <- numeric(half + 1)
  m_cat           <- numeric(half + 1)
  h2_cat          <- numeric(half + 1)
  
  M_tot <- sum(m)
  H_tot <- sum(vars)
  
  # Gradient vector and statistics for total genome density (v_tot)
  g_tot     <- rep(1 / M_tot, vc_num)
  v_tot     <- H_tot / M_tot
  var_v_tot <- as.numeric(t(g_tot) %*% Sigma %*% g_tot)
  
  # Loop over annotation categories (low + high LD bins per category)
  for (grp in seq_len(half)) {
    idx   <- c(2 * grp - 1, 2 * grp)
    M_grp <- sum(m[idx])
    H_grp <- sum(vars[idx])
    
    # Linear per-SNP density v = h2 / M
    v_grp <- H_grp / M_grp
    
    # Gradient vector for category density
    g_grp      <- rep(0, vc_num)
    g_grp[idx] <- 1 / M_grp
    
    # Delta Method variance and cross-covariance with v_tot
    var_v_grp     <- as.numeric(t(g_grp) %*% Sigma %*% g_grp)
    cov_v_grp_tot <- as.numeric(t(g_grp) %*% Sigma %*% g_tot)
    
    v[grp]               <- v_grp
    v_var[grp]           <- var_v_grp
    v_cat_tot_covar[grp] <- cov_v_grp_tot
    m_cat[grp]           <- M_grp
    h2_cat[grp]          <- H_grp
  }
  
  # Row (half + 1): Total Genome Baseline
  v[half + 1]               <- v_tot
  v_var[half + 1]           <- var_v_tot
  v_cat_tot_covar[half + 1] <- var_v_tot # Cov(v_tot, v_tot) = Var(v_tot)
  m_cat[half + 1]           <- M_tot
  h2_cat[half + 1]          <- H_tot
  
  # Single-ancestry Fold Enrichment (E) and Delta Method SE
  enr    <- v / v_tot
  enr_se <- numeric(half + 1)
  
  for (grp in seq_len(half)) {
    rel_var <- (v_var[grp] / (v[grp]^2)) + 
      (var_v_tot / (v_tot^2)) - 
      (2 * v_cat_tot_covar[grp] / (v[grp] * v_tot))
    enr_se[grp] <- enr[grp] * sqrt(max(0, rel_var))
  }
  enr_se[half + 1] <- 0 # Baseline relative to itself has zero error
  
  # Delta-method for Total genome h2 SE
  h2_tot_pve <- h_tot / V_total
  g_P_tot    <- rep(-h2_tot_pve / V_total, length(var_all))
  g_P_tot[1:vc_num] <- g_P_tot[1:vc_num] + 1 / V_total
  h2_SE_tot  <- sqrt(max(0, as.numeric(t(g_P_tot) %*% Sigma_with_total %*% g_P_tot)))
  
  res <- data.frame(
    m               = m_cat,
    h2_sum          = h2_cat,
    h2_SE.          = 
    v               = v,
    v_var           = v_var,
    FE_w            = 1 / v_var,
    v_cat_tot_covar = v_cat_tot_covar,
    enr             = enr,
    enr_se          = enr_se
  )
  
  return(res)
}
```

FUNCTION `meta_h2`: META analysis h2

```{r}
meta_h2 <- function(data) {
  split_df <- split(data, data$annotation)
  results <- data.frame(annotation = character(),
                      meta_h2 = numeric(),
                      meta_h2_se = numeric(),
                      meta_h2_p  = numeric(),
                      Q  = numeric(),
                      Q_p = numeric(),
                      I2 = numeric()
                      )
  for (ann in split_df) {
    re <- rma.uni(yi = ann$h2, sei = ann$h2_se, method = "REML")
    
    new_row <- data.frame(annotation = ann$annotation[1],
            meta_h2 = re$b[[1]],
            meta_h2_se = re$se,
            meta_h2_p  = re$pval,
            Q  = re$QE,
            Q_p = re$QEp,
            I2 = re$I2
            )
    results <- rbind(results, new_row)
  }
  return(results)
}
```

FUNCTION `meta_enr`: META analysis enrichment

```{r}
meta_enr <- function(data) {
  split_df <- split(data, data$annotation)
  results <- data.frame(annotation = character(),
                        meta_enr = numeric(),
                        meta_enr_se = numeric(),
                        meta_enr_p  = numeric(),
                        Q  = numeric(),
                        Q_p = numeric(),
                        I2 = numeric()
  )
  for (ann in split_df) {
    re <- rma.uni(yi = ann$enr, sei = ann$enr_se, method = "REML")
    
    new_row <- data.frame(annotation = ann$annotation[1],
                          meta_enr = re$b[[1]],
                          meta_enr_se = re$se,
                          meta_enr_p  = re$pval,
                          Q  = re$QE,
                          Q_p = re$QEp,
                          I2 = re$I2
    )
    results <- rbind(results, new_row)
 }
  return(results)
}

```

```{r}

amr <- read.csv(paste0(path, "amr_", trait, "_mph_", mph_suffix, ".mq.vc.csv"))

```

## Compute sums per annotation & MAF bin

```{r}

amr_sums_rc <- calc_sums(amr)
eur_sums_rc <- calc_sums(eur)
```

## 1.a T2D liability adjustments
```{r}
if(trait=="t2d_finalcontrols") {
  print("trait is t2d, adjusting h2_obs to l2_liab.")
  h2_liab <- c(0.346,0.458,0.425) # autosomal
  #h2_liab <- c(0.346590, 0.466773, 0.434580) # autosomal + X
  
  se_liab <- c(0.1284,0.0941,0.09996) # autosomal
  #se_liab <- c(0.065643, 0.048502, 0.049427) # autosomal + X
  
  h2_liab_not_ratio <- h2_liab/c(afr_sums_rc$h2_sum[15], amr_sums_rc$h2_sum[15],
                                 eur_sums_rc$h2_sum[15])
  
  # based on percent h2_cat in h2_total = percent of h2_liab_cat in h2_liab_total
  # don't need to recalculate enrichments because they are from the proportion of heritability!
  
  afr_sums_rc$h2_sum <- afr_sums_rc$h2_sum *h2_liab_not_ratio[[1]]
  amr_sums_rc$h2_sum <- amr_sums_rc$h2_sum *h2_liab_not_ratio[[2]]
  eur_sums_gem$h2_sum <- eur_sums_rc$h2_sum *h2_liab_not_ratio[[3]]
  
  afr_sums_rc$h2_SE <- afr_sums_rc$h2_SE *h2_liab_not_ratio[[1]]
  amr_sums_rc$h2_SE <- amr_sums_rc$h2_SE *h2_liab_not_ratio[[2]]
  eur_sums_rc$h2_SE <- eur_sums_rc$h2_SE *h2_liab_not_ratio[[3]]
} else {
  print("trait is not t2d")
} 
```

# 3. Summing all rare and all common h2s

Function `calc_rare_common`: merge rare, common, and total heritability/enrichments

```{r}
calc_rare_common <- function(data) {
  # Identify indices
  idx <- 1:28
  idx_rare <- idx[(idx - 1) %% 4 < 2]     # rows 1,2,5,6,...
  idx_common <- idx[(idx - 1) %% 4 >= 2]  # rows 3,4,7,8,...
  
  # Extract covariance matrix (cols 39–66)
  cov_mat <- as.matrix(data[, 39:66])
  
  # Function to compute variance of a sum
  calc_var <- function(indices) {
    sub_cov <- cov_mat[indices, indices]
    sum(sub_cov)  # includes variances + covariances automatically
  }
  
  # Compute h2
  h2_rare <- sum(data$pve[idx_rare])
  h2_common <- sum(data$pve[idx_common])
  
  # Compute SE
  se_rare <- round(sqrt(calc_var(idx_rare)), 7)
  se_common <- round(sqrt(calc_var(idx_common)), 7)
  
  # Output
  return(data.frame(
    category = c("rare", "common", "total"),
    h2_sum = c(h2_rare, h2_common, h2_rare+h2_common),
    h2_SE = c(se_rare, se_common, data$seP[29])
  ))
}
```

Function `calc_rare_common_ratio`: calculate rare to common heritability ratio

```{r}
calc_rare_common_ratio <- function(data) {
  # Identify indices
  idx <- 1:28
  idx_rare <- idx[(idx - 1) %% 4 < 2]     # rows 1,2,5,6,...
  idx_common <- idx[(idx - 1) %% 4 >= 2]  # rows 3,4,7,8,...
  
  # Extract covariance matrix (cols 39–66)
  cov_mat <- as.matrix(data[, 39:66])
  
  # Sum of PVE
  h2_rare <- sum(data$pve[idx_rare])
  h2_common <- sum(data$pve[idx_common])
  
  # Ratio
  ratio <- h2_rare / h2_common
  
  # Variances
  var_rare <- sum(cov_mat[idx_rare, idx_rare])
  var_common <- sum(cov_mat[idx_common, idx_common])
  
  # Covariance between the sums
  cov_rc <- sum(cov_mat[idx_rare, idx_common])
  
  # Delta-method variance of ratio
  var_ratio <-
    (1 / h2_common)^2 * var_rare +
    (h2_rare / h2_common^2)^2 * var_common -
    2 * (h2_rare / h2_common^3) * cov_rc
  
  se_ratio <- sqrt(var_ratio)
  
  # Output
  data.frame(
    ratio = ratio,
    ratio_SE = round(se_ratio, 7)
  )
}
```
